  - If there is a JetBlue charge but no trip showing, JetBlue support should be contacted immediately with:
    - Your full name
    - Travel dates and route
    - Last 4 digits of the card used
    - Approx. time of purchase (last night ~9pm PT)

4) If you want, tell me:
- Origin and destination airports/cities
- Date/time you tried to fly
- Last 4 digits of the card you used
And I’ll outline exactly what to say to JetBlue support and what to ask them to check in their system.</action>
